head: cloud/chat-max-completion-tokens
title: fix(serve): name max_completion_tokens in its Chat validation error
body:
Chat Completions reads its token limit from `max_completion_tokens`, falling back to `max_tokens` when that is absent or null. When the value is invalid, the 400 always said `'max_tokens' must be a positive integer`. So a client that sends only `max_completion_tokens: 0` was told about a field it never sent.

The error now names the field the limit was read from. The status, the `invalid_max_tokens` code and the precedence between the two fields are unchanged. `openai_chat_test` checks the message for an invalid value in each field.

Out of scope: when both fields are present, `max_tokens` is still ignored without validation. Rejecting an invalid ignored field would be a behavior change, so I left it out.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending. The change only affects Chat request validation, so no GPU path is touched.

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope (x86-64 CPU host, GCC 13.3, `cpu-test` preset, no GPU):
- Before the source change, the new `openai_chat_test` assertion failed ("an invalid token limit names the field that carried it"). After it, `ctest --test-dir build/cpu-test -R '^openai_chat_test$'` passes.
- `cmake --build --preset pr` (hosted contract suite): 56/56 tests passed. That run was before a formatting-only `--fix` of the new test, and `openai_chat_test` was rebuilt and passed again after the fix.
- `tools/ci/check-format.py` (clang-tools 21.1.8 via `nix shell`): PASS, 563 C++ files.
- Not run: sanitizers, functional tests or any model.
